profile.entities: Gensol Engineering Limited; Let'sEV (subs); Scorpius Trackers (subs); Refex Green Mobility (partner)
profile.subseg: Solar EPC; Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS); EV Manufacturing; EV Leasing
profile.themes: Order book surge; EV manufacturing debut; Balance sheet deleveraging; Margin recovery expected; Green hydrogen exploration

deepdive.sec: Renewable Energy / Solar EPC, Battery Storage & EV Manufacturing

bull_bear.body: Deleveraging EV debt via Refex sale (INR315cr); converting fund-based LCs to non-fund-based limits; equity raise of INR400cr pending from warrants (due Dec 2025); no dividend policy disclosed
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Land transfer delays from customers; Q4 execution risk; EV production ramp-up delays; promoter pledge remains high (81.7%); Refex transaction timing uncertainty; working capital pressure from EPC growth
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident on long-term vision, defensive on near-term guidance, acknowledges execution delays but attributes to external factors (rain, land); focused on deleveraging and EV production; avoids giving specific Q4 revenue numbers
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Deferred tax asset of INR2cr created due to EV leasing subsidiary’s past losses — a balance sheet benefit, not a revenue signal; Refex transaction is a balance sheet restructuring, not P&L revenue; Ezio pre-orders are non-binding, no cash advances received yet
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Solar EPC: 9M revenue INR1,056cr; BESS: 2 orders secured from GUVNL, execution in FY26; EV Leasing: AUM INR850cr, profitable since Q2; EV Manufacturing: Ezio and EZIBOT unveiled, 30,000 pre-orders, production to start FY26
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: Q3 margin dip due to higher BoS project execution (lower margin) due to delayed turnkey land handovers; 80% of order book is turnkey (higher margin); cost pressures mitigated by non-fund-based working capital optimization
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: sustained >40% YoY; margin: improving in Q4 due to turnkey mix; order inflow: INR3,000cr new wins in Q3; capex/commissioning: minimal for EPC; EV manufacturing capex ~INR15cr in 9M; EV leasing capex INR10-15cr
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR7,000cr (as of Dec 2024); includes 275MW (INR1,062cr), 245MW (INR968cr), and 225MW (INR898cr) projects at Khavda and NTPC; 80% turnkey, 20% BoS
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Green hydrogen exploration; international EV market entry (next 12-18 months); scaling BESS portfolio; monetizing EV leasing fleet via asset sales
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Gensol’s solar EPC order book surged to INR7,000cr with major wins at Khavda and from NTPC, while EV manufacturing launched with 30,000 pre-orders for Ezio, but Q3 revenue and margin misses were due to delayed land transfers and rain-impacted execution — the path to recovery hinges on Q4 catch-up and Refex EV sale closing.
